(def parse-long
  "Parse string of decimal digits with optional leading -/+ and return an\n  integer value, or nil if parse fails"

rationale: Original Clojure numeric-tower adaptation under ADR-0003. Preserve the public decimal-string API and docstring, but replace JavaScript regex/parseInt and safe-integer limits with checked exact signed-long parsing. The native helper reuses the complete pinned JVM UTF-16 Character.digit(char,10) domain; malformed/overflowing strings return nil and non-strings fail before coercion. The reader's separate private radix/literal parser is unchanged. Core remains an ordinary compiled first-class var in Runtime and Macro; no Java dependency is shipped. Clojure 1.12.6, not ClojureScript numeric recordings, is the behavior oracle.
